problem: Both appear to “call tools”; why are Function Calling and MCP not alternatives? Can inputSchema be passed through unchanged?
principle: Function Calling connects model and application; MCP connects application Client and capability Server. The Host adapts schemas, enforces policy and maps results. One proposal can use a direct SDK or MCP.
solutions: Dispatch proposal to trusted local adapter
Host uses Client to reach Server
Program decides which RPC to call
No need for model tool selection
MCP does not require Function Calling
check: Can Function Calling work without MCP, and MCP without a model?
answer: Yes. Local functions can execute model proposals; ordinary programs can use MCP. The reference runs real MCP without a model request.
